## CookieExpiryInfo.decidedBy property

Which attribute determined the final expiry:

- `'max-age'` - a valid `Max-Age` attribute was present (it takes precedence over `Expires`<!-- -->, per RFC6265 S4.1.2.2) - `'expires'` - no valid `Max-Age`<!-- -->, but a valid `Expires` attribute - `'session'` - neither attribute was valid; the cookie is a session cookie

**Signature:**

```typescript
decidedBy: 'max-age' | 'expires' | 'session';
```
